# Chessori

> Chessori is a curated chess news site. For a small set of the day's most
> newsworthy chess stories, it publishes an original companion analysis
> piece alongside a link to the original source article -- never a
> reworded summary. Companion pieces are AI-drafted (Claude, credited as
> "Claude Henry" on every article) under human editorial review before
> publishing, and add real context: a historical parallel, the money/
> economics angle, community reaction (grounded in live web search, not
> speculation), or original reporting drawn from Chess Tournament
> Calendar's own tournament database.

## Key facts

- Every article's frontmatter and byline names its real primary source;
  the source URL is always linked, both inline and at the article's end.
- Article images are real, correctly licensed photos from Wikimedia
  Commons (never scraped from the source outlet), with visible credit and
  a link back to the original file.
- "reviewStatus: published" in an article's frontmatter is the signal a
  human editor has reviewed and approved that specific piece.

## Content

- Homepage: https://chessori.com/ -- latest published articles.
- Per-continent sections: https://chessori.com/continent/{europe,asia,north-america,south-america,africa,oceania,global}/
- RSS feed of all published articles: https://chessori.com/rss.xml
- Sitemap: https://chessori.com/sitemap-index.xml

## Reuse

Article text may be quoted with attribution to Chessori and a link back
to the specific article. The original source article linked from each
piece carries its own outlet's rights, separate from Chessori's own
analysis text.
